title: Civic Engagement in Governance
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Six elective positions at a general election: President, Governor, Senator, Member of the National Assembly, Woman Representative, MCA. Name no party or person.

skills.key_step: The child names individual and collective civic activities, the role of political parties and the six elective positions.

misconceptions.ask: Which post is vied for in a general election?

misconceptions.ask: A youth group cleans a market together. Is this individual or collective civic engagement?
